hints.title: Four Direction Arm Lengths
hints.text: The arm length of a plus sign centered at any cell is the minimum length among its four cardinal directions.

hints.title: Directional Sweeps
hints.text: Compute consecutive ones in four passes: left to right, right to left, top to bottom, and bottom to top.

hints.title: Consolidation of Minimums
hints.text: Maintain the running minimum arm length at each cell across all four direction passes and return the maximum value observed across the entire grid.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Four linear passes over the grid keeping running minimum consecutive ones.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding outward from every cell can cost O(N) per cell leading to O(N^3) total time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: An N by N grid records directional prefix counts in O(N^2) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reuse the grid matrix to take pointwise minimums across all 4 sweeps.
